findings.comment: Site plan shows existing overhead electric lines along southern boundary. Proposed buildings are shown in plan view, but no surveyed conductor elevations or building elevation sheets are provided to verify that buildings maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside conductor as measured from ground level to conductor.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings, particularly Buildings 6 and 8 near southern overhead line
findings.comment: Site plan shows proposed buildings with some having locations near existing overhead electric facilities along the southern boundary. No building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor locations or section views demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) are provided for verification.

applicableAreas: All buildings near property boundaries with overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Existing overhead electric facilities are located within electric easements adjacent to the site boundary along Valley View Road and the southern property line. Site plan does not provide dimension annotations or clearance verification exhibits demonstrating that buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance from these existing overhead facilities.

applicableAreas: All buildings (Buildings 1-8) potentially within clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided that include surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations. Without surveyed conductor location data and building elevation exhibits with dimension lines originating from the outside conductor location, vertical clearances cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6 and 8 and proposed structures near southern overhead line
findings.comment: Section views and enlarged plan details showing dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections are not provided on the submitted site plan. Clearance verification from the outside conductor location cannot be performed.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where concrete retaining wall is proposed
findings.comment: Proposed concrete retaining wall runs along the southern property line in the same location as the existing overhead electric line shown on the existing conditions survey. Section views and clearance dimension annotations from the outside electric line conductor to the wall face are not provided on the retaining wall detail sheets (Sheets 38-39). No evidence of minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Proposed concrete retaining wall along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Retaining wall detail sheets (Sheets 38-39) show cross-sections and structural details but lack dimension annotations showing clearance from the outside electric conductor to the outermost edge (face) of the proposed wall. Cross-sectional exhibits do not include surveyed conductor elevation or clearance verification dimensions.

applicableAreas: Site plan annotations where clearances are shown
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on the site plan between proposed structures and the existing overhead electric facilities. Cannot verify whether any dimension annotations that may exist on other details originate from the outside conductor rather than the utility pole centerline.

applicableAreas: Proposed retaining wall and site features near southern overhead electric line
findings.comment: Vertical clearance from the existing overhead electric facilities to the proposed retaining wall and grading along the southern property line appears marginal or insufficient based on available site plan data. No registered surveyor mid-span clearance data showing measured clearances at mid-span of the overhead line above the finished grade and structures has been provided for verification.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near overhead electric line where mitigation trees are proposed
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows tree plantings with canopies overlapping the overhead electric line along the southern boundary, but no species identifications are provided on the landscape plan itself. Tree list (Sheet 32) shows various species with Appendix F designations, but spatial mapping of which specific trees are planted near the overhead line is not clear from the documents. Cannot verify whether trees within 10 lateral feet of distribution conductors are from the Utility Compatible species list in ECM Appendix F or within 50 lateral feet of transmission conductors.

applicableAreas: Entire site with overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Cover sheet and general notes sheets (Sheets 1-3) do not include a note requiring that the owner/contractor notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines as required by Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. This requirement must be added to site plans whenever overhead electric lines exist on or adjacent to the site.
